fusions.name: Ploughed Furrow
fusions.desc: Drags a heavy yoke of chain through a cone ahead of you, which deals 13 damage to everything within 4 tiles and knocks it back 3 tiles, with a 50% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Team Haul
fusions.desc: Hauls a weighted chain into an enemy up to 6 tiles away for 28 damage, up to 1.5 times that at full reach; its damage rises 10% for each ally beside you, up to 30%. On a hit, every ally gains 20% damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Steady Yoke
fusions.desc: Restores 3 stamina a second for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Belled Collar
fusions.desc: Conjures a collar of links: your critical chance rises by 4%, your critical hits deal 10% more damage, each kill restores 3 health, and your maximum health rises by 15.
